source: hand-built EMV payload to exercise the "no scheme recognised" branch of detect()
note: Tag 29 holds AID A000000999, which no supported scheme uses. CRC computed with conformance/tools/crc16.py (independent Python CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE). Not a real QR. errorFields: the top-level TLV split of the payload, tag 63 (CRC) included, done by hand (the length of each field read from its two digits).
